name: Chapel Hill
seo_title: Chapel Hill Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Chapel Hill, North Carolina for 2026: 4 family events, 2 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Chapel Hill celebrates Christmas with a parade shared with Carrboro, a Santa visit in University Place and a long run of holiday days at 1870 Farm.
celebrates: The Chapel Hill-Carrboro Community Holiday Parade on December 5 begins on West Franklin Street and ends at the Carrboro Town Commons, presented by both towns and Chapel Hill Community Arts & Culture. University Place invites families to Santa Rolls Into UP on December 4, when Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive on a fire truck. The Downtown Chapel Hill Partnership lights the community tree on December 6 with caroling. 1870 Farm holds its 10th annual Holiday at the Farm on nine dates in December.
lastyear: 1870 Farm calls its 2026 Holiday at the Farm the 10th annual, so last year's was the ninth. The farm's visit page still shows 2025 time slots, which is why this guide does not print 2026 hours for the farm. The parade is shared with the Town of Carrboro, and Carrboro's calendar lists a later start time than the host does, so arrive early to see the first floats.
facts: The parade starts at 140 West Franklin Street and ends at the Carrboro Town Commons, 301 West Main Street. University Place is at 201 South Estes Drive, and its Santa event runs 6 to 9 pm with s'mores, games and live music. 1870 Farm is at 1224 Old Lystra Road, and its barn is unheated with campfires while the farmhouse is heated.
trains: There is no train ride in Chapel Hill itself. The closest family train outing we have verified is the North Carolina Transportation Museum in Spencer, in Rowan County, which offers 25-minute train rides. Raleigh also has family train rides, including the New Hope Valley Railway Santa Express, which our Raleigh guide covers. Plan those as a separate day out from a Chapel Hill weekend.
train_links: Admission from $10, or $20 with a 25-minute train ride, at the old Spencer Shops in Spencer.
traditions: A joint Chapel Hill and Carrboro parade from Franklin Street to Carrboro on December 5.
Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive by fire truck at University Place on December 4.
Caroling and the lighting of the downtown tree on December 6.
Nine dates of Santa, an elf workshop and a festival of lights at 1870 Farm.
kidfact: At 1870 Farm, every child who meets Santa receives a toy, according to the host's holiday page.
faq: What Christmas events can kids enjoy in Chapel Hill?

Families can watch the Chapel Hill-Carrboro Community Holiday Parade, meet Santa at University Place, sing at the Downtown Chapel Hill tree lighting or spend a day at 1870 Farm. Each listing shows the date and price rules, and each links to the host's page.
Is the Chapel Hill Christmas parade free?

Yes. The Chapel Hill-Carrboro Community Holiday Parade is free to watch. It starts on West Franklin Street at about 10 am on December 5, 2026, and finishes in Carrboro, so plan for walking or a ride back to your car afterward.
Where can children meet Santa in Chapel Hill?

University Place hosts free pictures with Santa on December 4, and 1870 Farm offers Santa visits during Holiday at the Farm. The farm page does not print a 2026 price or hours, so check its booking page before you plan the day around it.
Is there a tree lighting in Chapel Hill?

Yes. The Downtown Chapel Hill Partnership announced a community tree lighting with caroling on Sunday, December 6, 2026, at 6:30 pm. The host post does not print a price or an end time, so confirm the details with the Partnership before you go and dress warmly.
